translations.english: The city, resembling a half-moon and beautified by the Yamuna's banks, was adorned with grand houses, squares, shops, and streets, inhabited by people of all four varnas, and bustling with diverse commerce.
translations.hindi: माता के समान गुणवान्‌ होने क॑ कारण राजा का अपने राज्ञ कुमार -पूरु पर विशेष स्नेह था. । यह देख, बहुत दुःखो हो दूसरे राजकुमार यदु ने अपनी माता से कहा
